name: Carpocalypse 2 Vita
author: bojan1986819
description: A native PS Vita port of Carmageddon II: Carpocalypse Now (1998), built on the Carpocalypse 2 decompilation by Link4Electronics/Carpocalypse2. This fork's main focus is the Vita build (v1.0). Along the way it also continued the decompilation, fixed a number of bugs in the game code, and extended the PC (Windows) port; see Changes in this fork.
